name: More Chat Messages
author: SCUMSA
description: Announce what happens on your server in the game's own chat. Kills, players joining and leaving, cargo drops, game events opening and starting, bunkers opening and closing, and bases being raided - each one switched on separately, sent to the chat channel you choose, and worded however you like. Everything ships off, so nothing is announced until you say so.

needs.why: Cargo drops and the competitive game events are in no log the manager reads and in no table of SCUM.db - the only place they exist is the running game, and this module is what reports them. Without these switches those two announcements have nothing to watch and stay silent; every other announcement here reads the server's own log and is unaffected. Naming each person who signs up for an event additionally needs 'players' ("Who is in the event"), which is left out of this list on purpose: it costs the game a call per participant per poll, so it is an owner's choice rather than something a plugin should switch on for them.
